name: Iyuku
sum: An iguanodontian from the Early Cretaceous Kirkwood Formation of South Africa, known from a bonebed of juveniles and hatchlings.
wsnote: The material is juvenile, so no adult size is given.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; from a bonebed in the Kirkwood Formation.
material: At least 27 juvenile and hatchling individuals, counted from non-overlapping left femora.
exceptional: A bonebed of hatchlings and juveniles, unusual for the group.
biology: The name means "hatchling" in Xhosa; the early growth stage of the specimens makes phylogenetic placement hard, so the authors assigned it only to Iguanodontia.
author: Forster et al. 2022

sources.text: Forster CA, de Klerk WJ, Poole KE, Chinsamy-Turan A, Roberts EM, Ross CF 2022. ''Iyuku raathi'', a new iguanodontian dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous Kirkwood Formation, South Africa. The Anatomical Record 306(7): 1762–1803. doi:10.1002/ar.25038

Poole, K 2022. Placing juvenile specimens in phylogenies: An ontogenetically sensitive phylogenetic assessment of a new genus of iguanodontian dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous Kirkwood Formation, South Africa. The Anatomical Record 306(7): 1939–1950. doi:10.1002/ar.25095
